svg.title: Illustration of an OSAS private note in a Chatwoot conversation
svg.desc: A customer asks for a refund. Below it, a private note from OSAS lists the policy reasons and states that nothing has been executed.
svg.text: Customer: I want a refund for my order.
PRIVATE NOTE · visible to agents only

g.text: - IDENTITY_UNVERIFIED: rule requires a verified identity
- REGION_UNLISTED: region 'ZZ' is not in allowedRegions
- INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: refund needs at least one evidence reference
Evidence: none attached (Chatwoot holds no order data)
Not verified against any order system. Check the order before acting.
Shadow mode: nothing has been executed.
Refs: proposal prop_1 / shadow run shadow_...

svg.text: Illustration, not a screenshot. Text follows the note written in the real Chatwoot 4.18.0 end-to-end run; lines shortened for width.
